visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing rectangular glasses and a dark graphic t-shirt, is positioned centrally in the frame. He has a large, colorful tattoo on his inner left forearm. He cups both hands around his mouth, mimicking a shouting gesture with an open mouth. The room behind him appears to be a professional esports studio featuring various trophies and a neon "Flash" sign. (2) The scene cuts to another young man wearing a black and white "Flash Wolves" team jersey. He has short black hair and waves his right hand enthusiastically at the camera with a bright smile. Animated pink hearts and white sparkles float across the screen as visual overlays. (3) The camera returns to the first man in the dark t-shirt who repeats the shouting gesture towards the viewer. The background lighting is indoor and slightly dim with glowing blue and white neon elements. (4) The second young man in the jersey is shown again, this time performing small dance movements and hand gestures in a medium shot. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the face of the man in the jersey as he continues to smile warmly directly into the camera lens. (6) He turns his body ninety degrees to the right and begins walking away from the camera into the background as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched J-pop music with a fast tempo (~160 BPM) and energetic synthesized drum beats begins instantly. A male vocal line sings an opening phrase with high-arousal brightness. (2) A sharp "pop" sound effect triggers a new phase. A male voice says "Ha-i!" with a clear, rising intonation and a cheerful, melodic tone. (3) The BGM continues with high energy. A male voice asks a question in Japanese, rhythmically synchronized with the electronic beat. The vocal pitch is high and delivery is sharp. (4) The vocals transition into a melodic singing line: "Strawberry flavor..." in Japanese. The tone is smooth, playful, and friendly. (5) The melodic vocal line concludes the phrase with a positive emotional valence. (6) A sudden transition occurs where the music cuts out and is replaced by a dense recording of a crowd cheering and applauding. The sound is bright and consists of many overlapping voices and rhythmic clapping.
